ios.desc:
seen
Your Personal AI Stylist

You’ve always known how you want to look — you just never had a mirror that reflected it back until now.

Make My Outfit is your AI outfit maker, outfit generator, and personal fashion stylist in one. You know what looks good — you just need a personalized boutique that assembles the fit and helps you shop the complete look at once instead of piece by piece. It blends the swipeable fun of dress up games and fashion games and Tinder with real‑world, shoppable outfits.

Dress in 60 seconds, not 60 tabs

Everyone gets 3 free outfit generations / try ons a week! You can subscribe to pro for unlimited generations or wait and get reloaded every Sunday :) For catwalk videos, users must purchase credits to generate.

KEY FEATURES

* Swipe to Style: Swipe right on outfits you love, left to refine. Our AI outfit maker learns your taste and gets smarter with every swipe. Feels like a modern dress up game for your real life.
* Virtual Try‑On: Upload your photo and see the outfit on you in seconds. Magic, pocket‑sized — like your favorite fashion games, but on you.
* Improve Your Outfit - Upload a photo of your outfit and get small tweaks to tie it together.
* Shop the Look: One tap to buy the entire fit — exact matches or smart lookalikes — not just one-off items. Save reusable outfit formulas.
* AI Outfit Creation: From mood to runway‑ready. Tell us the occasion and our AI outfit generator builds a cohesive look start‑to‑finish — your personal fashion game that turns prompts into polished looks.
* Outfit Planner: Save favorites, plan your week, and keep go‑to looks at hand — a wardrobe clothing app without the chaos. Turn style play into a plan.
* Instant Feedback Loop: “More casual,” “brighter colors,” “add a jacket.” Stop chatting; just say it and get fresh variations.

HOW IT WORKS

1) Swipe to design your outfit

Refine your vibe with quick swipes and simple prompts. Behind the scenes, our AI learns from every “yes” and “no” to become your super stylist. Prefer minimal, coquette, or streetwear? Your personalized AI curates fits you’ll actually wear. It feels like a dress up game: fast, visual, and fun.

2) Try it on your AI twin

Upload a photo and preview the clothes on you — the fastest way to try on a look before you buy. Adjust details (“tuck the shirt,” “longer coat,” “sleeker shoes”) to recreate yourself or explore a new aesthetic. Bring the try‑on magic of fashion games to your camera roll.

3) Shop the look (not the piece)
